description: This is a C# source file that defines a benchmarking class `StructSerializeBenchmark` which compares the serialization performance of various serializers (such as Orleans, Utf8Json, System.Text.Json, MessagePack, ProtobufNet, Hyperion, ZeroFormatter, Newtonsoft.Json, and SpanJson) on a struct type `IntStruct`. The class includes setup logic for serializers and multiple benchmark methods.

classes.name: StructSerializeBenchmark
classes.description: A benchmarking class that compares serialization performance for struct types across various serializers.

methods.name: Orleans
methods.description: Performs serialization using Orleans serializer and returns the length of the serialized data.

methods.name: Utf8Json
methods.description: Serializes `Input` to UTF8 JSON using Utf8Json and returns the length of the output.

methods.description: Serializes `Input` using System.Text.Json and returns the length of the output.

methods.name: MessagePackCSharp
